meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让一支敌对的多智能体团队在你把方案定稿前互相挑刺，提前暴露致命漏洞。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果重大方案即将拍板,你想在定稿前被彻底挑刺。
copy.tagline_en: Have adversarial agents cross-critique your plan before you lock it down.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a high-stakes plan is about to be locked and you want it stress-tested first.

howto.what: Claude 会带队一个 5 人互相对抗的规划团队,成员彼此攻击各自的结论;只有经得起攻击的见解被保留,再交给专职规划者写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度,或你要求「hyperplan」「对抗式」「交叉批判」计划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次数据库迁移。
say.note: 会启动 5 人对抗团队互相批判。

say.text: 对这个方案做对抗式交叉批判,再出正式计划。
say.note: 先互相攻击,再交规划者formalize。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划登录重构,重点攻击过度设计。
say.note: 怀疑者会负责削减复杂度。

howto.what_en: Claude leads a 5-member hostile planning team whose members attack each other's findings; only defensible insights survive and go to a dedicated planner for formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or when you ask for a hyperplan / adversarial / cross-critique plan.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this database migration.
Cross-critique this plan adversarially, then formalize it.
say_en.note: Members attack first, then a planner writes it up.

say_en.text: Hyperplan this login refactor; attack over-engineering.
